Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and for the template. A few items from procurement: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@novahealth.com (Linda Park, Vendor Management). Please send completed packet and W-9 there.
- Required docs: our vendor setup requires a completed packet, a current W-9 (for US entities), and banking details for ACH. For non-US vendors we request a W-8 and local tax docs.
- Portal: we use Coupa for vendor onboarding. If you can create a vendor record in Coupa or provide the packet via email we can start intake.
- PO vs card: Preferred is PO for any contract > $5k; card is used for ad-hoc/one-off invoices under $5k.
- Marketplace: we prefer to purchase via AWS Marketplace when available, but procurement can process a PO if Redwood is not listed. Is Redwood listed on AWS Marketplace?

Estimated setup timeline: vendor intake + review 2-3 weeks (procurement + finance), legal review of any non-standard terms may add time. Please include SOC2 Type II report or link to our security portal for evidence.

Attachments: vendor_setup_form.xlsx, novahealth_W-9.pdf (procurement provided template)

I will route things to procurement@novahealth.com once we receive the completed materials.

Regards,
Olivia Brown
Head of Platform
